# KafkaDiskFillingUp

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-pods](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-pods/) | 1h / 5m |

**Summary:** Kafka volume <persistentvolumeclaim> will be full within 24 h

At the growth rate of the last 6 hours the data volume of broker <kafka_broker> (<pod>) runs out of space within a day. A full log dir takes the broker offline: reduce retention, add disk or rebalance partitions.

## Impact

When the volume is full the broker marks its log dir offline; all partitions on it become unavailable on this replica.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · Topics, Partitions & Storage → fastest growing topics and size forecast; Kafka · Pods & Nodes → volume usage.

## Mitigation

- Reduce retention (retention.ms / retention.bytes) of the growing topics, expand the PVC, or move partitions to other brokers.

## Expression

```promql
(predict_linear(kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes[6h], 24 * 3600) < 0 and kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes < 0.25) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (kafka_cluster, kafka_broker, pod) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, pod) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (kafka_cluster, kafka_broker) (max by (namespace, pod, kafka_cluster, kafka_broker) (kafka_server_kafkaserver_brokerstate) * 0 + 1))
```
